comparison.objective: Retrofit a split cable guide at a panel and verify service-drawer travel; candidate calibrates a gripper stop and verifies jaw motion.
comparison.physical_skill: Fit a split guide around a connected cable, close a keeper, preserve plugs, and trigger drawer travel versus counterhold a stop screw while tightening its jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: Guide locked before release, drawer travels at least 48 mm, sleeve clears, plugs remain seated, and proof holds two seconds; loss conditions permanently fail.
comparison.reason: Both include hands-off functional verification, but guide installation and cable-clearance proof do not test preservation of a threaded angular setting under locknut torque.
